issue.title: Add the canonical just check file-change verification entry point
issue.description: On e77bbe3, just check exits 1 before any verification: error: justfile does not contain recipe check. just --list shows fmt/lint/test/all plus adapter/smoke recipes, but neither check nor symvision. The missing check recipe predates bob-cli-3b (the justfile last changed on 44bfe58, before the first epic commit 6d54e39). Provide a supported just check gate using existing Rust verification commands, documenting its scope; do not invent or run just check-full. Existing pre-existing test/lint defects keep their own tracking (environment race bob-cli-2e; active bob-cli-28 owns the clippy solo-link assertion).

task_type_fields.impact: SASE landing agents cannot execute the requested file-change verification gate.
task_type_fields.repro: Run just check on e77bbe3 or 6d54e39^; it consistently exits 1 with missing recipe before running a check. Compare just --list and existing all/fmt/lint/test recipes.

issue.creation_reason: Landing bob-cli-3b was instructed to verify file changes with just check, but the recipe is absent on both its base and current master. Track this unrelated verification-infrastructure gap separately from the freshness feature.

evidence.note: Independent bob-cli-3i landing repro on master 74f47d4: just check exits 1 with error: justfile does not contain recipe check. just --list confirms fmt/lint/test/all exist and neither check nor symvision is available. This predates the sub-bullet task-block epic; retain the existing infrastructure task, do not duplicate or expand bob-cli-3i scope, and use documented native fmt/lint/test fallbacks for its remaining tale.

Independent bob-cli-3l landing repro on master 923adb8: just check exits 1 with missing recipe before verification. just --list also lacks symvision. The recipe absence predates bob-cli-3l; cargo fmt --check, 1535 lib tests, and 416 capture CLI tests pass through the existing Rust commands. Keep the verification-entry-point defect in this existing task.

Independent bob-cli-3v landing repro on master 89acf06: the landing prompt asks for just check, but just --list shows only all/fmt/lint/test, check-scripts, check-adapter, check-web-clip-adapter, package-list, install, install-smoke. Neither check nor symvision exists. Used cargo fmt --check plus cargo test (1599 lib + 909 cli, all green) as the fallback. Predates bob-cli-3v.

Independent bob-cli-46 landing repro on master 192e8b5: just check exits 1 with Justfile does not contain recipe check. The justfile still exposes fmt/lint/test/all and install-smoke and lacks symvision. just fmt passes; cargo clippy fails only on the pre-existing bob-cli-28 assertion. This is the same missing verification entry point, not new command-tree work; no duplicate task and no check-full run.

Independent bob-cli-4f landing reproduction on bob-cli master 2152202: just check exits 1 with Justfile does not contain recipe check; just --list also has no symvision. Neither bob-cli nor bob-plugins has any just check-full run in this landing. The epic changed only the linked plugin source/test layout; primary justfile is unchanged. Used accepted bob-plugins gates instead: npm test 1809/1809, npm run validate 6/6, source parity (64 helpers/73 methods), and all 22 split test files independently (297 cases). This is the existing verification-entry-point infrastructure defect; no new task.

Independent bob-cli-4i.7 landing reproduction on db1da70: just check exits 1 with Justfile does not contain recipe check; just --list also has no symvision. Primary justfile is unchanged throughout bob-cli-4i and bob-cli-4i.7. Use native Rust fmt/test/lint verification; no check-full run. Same pre-existing infrastructure defect, no new task.

Independent bob-cli-4q landing reproduction on ade4b8a: just check exits 1 immediately because justfile has no check recipe; just --list also has no symvision. Predates this docs-and-plugins epic. Current plugin gates pass (npm test 1988/1988, validate 6/6) and just fmt passes; no check-full was run.

Independent bob-cli-55 landing reproduction on master 092e098: just check exits 1 immediately with Justfile does not contain recipe check. just --list also has no symvision. The justfile is identical to the epic base. Used cargo fmt, targeted freshness tests (111 lib + 43 CLI), npm test (2105 passing) and npm validate (6/6). Known Clippy and completion failures keep their existing owners; no check-full run or duplicate task.
